_meta.title: CPN public security advisories
_meta.description: Canonical machine-readable log of fixed vulnerabilities for CPN Control Panel Network. Keep in sync with docs/SECURITY-ADVISORIES.md and site/data/security-advisories.json. Do not invent entries; publish only after a fix ships and users have a reasonable upgrade path.

entry_fields.cve: CVE id when assigned, else null
entry_fields.ghsa: GitHub Security Advisory id when published, else null
entry_fields.title: Short title
entry_fields.severity: One of: critical, high, medium, low
entry_fields.published: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (site displays as dd/mm/yyyy)
entry_fields.remediation: Upgrade instruction and any interim mitigation
entry_fields.references: Array of URL strings (GHSA, release notes, commits)
